full_text: The Barangay assembly shall: (a) Initiate legislative processes by recommending to the Sangguniang Barangay the adoption of measures for the welfare of the Barangay and the city or municipality concerned; (b) Decide on the adoption of initiative as a legal process whereby the registered voters of the Barangay may directly propose, enact, or amend any ordinance; and (c) Hear and pass upon the semestral report of the Sangguniang Barangay concerning its activities and finances. CHAPTER 7 - KATARUNGANG PAMBARANGAY
